title: Portland-based Mueon, which says its AI server racks could fit up to 10x more computing capacity, raised $65M led by Maverick Silicon, with Intel participating (Phoebe Liu/The Information)
summary: Phoebe Liu / The Information: Portland-based Mueon, which says its AI server racks could fit up to 10x more computing capacity, raised $65M led by Maverick Silicon, with Intel participating — Portland-based startup Mueon raised $65 million to develop a new way to arrange AI server rack components.
